source.title: scikit-learn official documentation — Nearest Neighbors
source.quote: simply stores instances of the training data.

finding.zh: 当前定义用参数学习解释训练，作为入门示例可理解，但若被读成全部机器学习的唯一机制，范围过窄。官方最近邻分类资料提供了保存训练实例的对照。
finding.en: The current definitions explain training through parameter learning, which is understandable as an introductory example but too narrow if interpreted as the only mechanism in all machine learning. Official nearest-neighbor classification documentation provides a contrasting instance-storage approach.

proposedCaveat.zh: 这里以参数学习模型说明训练与推理。其他学习方法可能保存训练实例或建立索引等状态；不能把是否更新数值权重当作所有学习方法的唯一判断标准，应结合实际算法与学习/预测流程。
proposedCaveat.en: Training and inference are illustrated here with parameter-learning models. Other learning methods may retain training instances or build index state; numerical weight updates are not the sole criterion across all learning methods. Inspect the actual algorithm and its learning/prediction process.

authoredCounterexample.zh: 已给定这是最近邻分类方法：学习阶段保存带标签训练实例，预测时按邻居标签分类。仅因为没有拟合神经网络权重，就说它“不是机器学习”，结论不成立。
authoredCounterexample.en: The method is explicitly specified as nearest-neighbor classification: its learning stage retains labeled training instances, and prediction uses neighbor labels. The absence of fitted neural-network weights does not justify calling it "not machine learning".

boundaries.zh: 非参数不等于没有配置；本来源的邻居数k可由用户设定，不应混同训练学出的权重。
boundaries.en: Non-parametric does not mean configuration-free: the source allows user-selected neighbor count k, which should not be confused with fitted weights.

boundaries.zh: 不能反过来把任何保存文本都叫训练；RAG新增资料与实例学习仍需根据实际方法区分。
boundaries.en: Do not infer that any stored text is training; distinguish added RAG material from instance-based learning by the actual method.

boundaries.zh: 不要把文档中non-generalizing的术语误解为不能对新样本预测；本例不评价任何方法必然更好。
boundaries.en: Do not interpret the documentation’s term non-generalizing as inability to predict new samples; the illustration does not claim a method is necessarily better.

recommendedUse: Optional scope note for authors; retain the parameter-learning assumption when using the existing training/inference example. No frozen knowledge or B input is changed.
